name: genpark-agentic-post-purchase-dispute-arbiter-skill
description: Autonomous Agentic Post-Purchase Tracking & Delivery Dispute Arbiter (inspired by Meta Muse, Shopify, Walmart, Instacart Post-Checkout Operations). Ingests carrier webhook events, tracks transit anomalies (stalled shipments, delivery failures), calculates compensation eligibility, and generates structured merchant claim payloads.

tools.name: arbitrate_post_purchase_dispute
tools.description: Post-checkout telemetry and dispute arbitration: track multi-carrier shipping updates, detect delay anomalies, assess refund eligibility, and generate merchant dispute claim payloads.

carrier_events.description: Timeline of tracking events from carrier.

claim_reason.description: Reason for dispute (e.g. STALLED_SHIPMENT, LOST_PACKAGE, DAMAGED).
